problem: Use dd^c=(i/(2 pi))partial barpartial; X is connected and compact. All potentials are genuine canonical psh-plus-smooth representatives. Let n>=2. Assume X has a smooth positive balanced Hermitian form beta with d(beta^(n-1))=0 and a smooth positive pluriclosed Hermitian form omega with dd^c omega=0. They may be different metrics. The associated conjecture is that X is Kahler, i.e. admits a smooth d-closed positive real (1,1)-form. The original programme asks to use this coexistence to construct closed positive data (a closed Kahler current would suffice), or to control a geometric flow changing torsion; identify the estimate beyond finite balanced trace that prevents metric degeneration, and determine whether Gauduchon determinant estimates can provide it. The flow variant also assumes c1(X)=0 in real cohomology and asks for long-time existence and convergence of pluriclosed flow to a Kahler metric. If a flow is used, specify its evolution, normalization, admissible initial data and precise convergence. The standard pluriclosed evolution uses minus the (1,1) part of the Bismut Ricci form; time-scale conventions must be specified. A single metric both balanced and pluriclosed is already Kahler. A pluriclosed manifold in Fujiki class is known Kahler. Finite conserved balanced trace in invariant examples is not pointwise ellipticity and does not preclude degeneration. Scalar potential perturbations preserve d(omega+dd^c u)=d omega, so prescribing a volume cannot itself remove torsion. Let h be a smooth Hermitian metric and dV a smooth positive probability volume. Let G_h consist of all positive (n-1,n-1)-currents T with dd^c T=0 and integral h wedge T=1. Write sigma_T=h wedge T; in an h-unitary frame let P_T be the positive Hermitian matrix density characterized by beta wedge T=(1/n)tr(B P_T)d sigma_T, tr(P_T)=n, for B the h-relative matrix of any smooth (1,1)-form beta. The determinant measure Gamma_0(T)=(dV/h^n)^(1/n)det(P_T)^(1/n)sigma_T is absolutely continuous with respect to dV. Define k_T=d Gamma_0(T)/dV. For smooth strictly positive T=gamma^(n-1), k_T=(gamma^n/dV)^((n-1)/n). The family G_h includes singular and degenerate currents, and the endpoint is over all currents, not only smooth exact maximizers. Define v_minus(h) as the infimum of the total bounded-potential Monge-Ampere masses over all bounded genuine h-psh potentials. No candidate geometric condition, flow estimate or proof is supplied.
completionCriteria: Prove closed positive data or precise geometric-flow control from the balanced/pluriclosed coexistence, addressing the estimate needed beyond finite balanced trace and the role or limitation of full Gauduchon determinant bounds. A general Kahlerness or long-time flow claim must retain every original hypothesis and prove every conclusion. A genuinely new fully specified sufficient-condition theorem may be recorded as restricted, but cannot close the unrestricted coexistence or flow conjectures. A restatement of the same-metric case, conserved total trace or scalar prescribed-volume equation is insufficient. Verify indispensable external premises at primary sources and independently reconstruct every theorem.
